Hours Between Two Date-Times

Find the exact time difference between two dates and times — days, hours, minutes, seconds and decimal hours.

—

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the first date and time.
  2. Enter the second date and time.
  3. The exact difference appears instantly — days, hours, minutes, seconds and decimal hours.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does it matter which date I enter first?

Yes — the tool always returns the absolute (positive) difference, whichever date is earlier.

Can it handle spans crossing midnight?

Both are exact to the second, so overnight spans like 23:00 → 01:00 are handled correctly.

What are decimal hours for?

Decimal hours are useful for timesheets, billing and payroll — e.g. 7.5 hours = 7 hours 30 minutes.
